policy.kubernetes_identity: one dedicated no-RBAC service account per workload; API token automount disabled unless explicitly required
policy.secret_material: SecretRef or external provider only; values never enter catalog, ConfigMap, logs or evidence
policy.backend_identity: unique least-privilege principal per workload and backend; shared admin/root accounts forbidden
policy.tenant_authority: authenticated claims or verified probe identity only; request payload/header/query is never authoritative
policy.service_transport: unique service identity with mTLS for service-to-service and probe traffic
policy.rotation: trust bundle first, dual identity window, cutover acknowledgement, old credential revocation and reconcile
policy.privileged_workload: explicit exception, minimum capabilities, node admission and per-release independent review

privileged_exception.reason: packet capture requires host network and approved capture capabilities
privileged_exception.required_review: capability and node admission review per release
